the logit, the Tullock, and the difference-form CSFs are the unique CSFs satisfying (a) the independence of irrelevant alternatives, (b) the symmetry, and (c) the monotonicity axioms, in the case of two contestants.

the axiomatic approach to CSFs is not unique but that there are at least two different approaches, one of which, the common-pool perspective, is new.
